name: preship-commit-verdict-not-naming-head
setupDescription: one passing verdict that records no revision

expect.stderr:
@@GATE_BLOCK@@
Gate 2 structural check FAILED — ship blocked.

Verdict tasks/reviews/261101-corpus-demo-verdict.md does not name the revision under review (b5c9dd3).
A verdict with no matching revision cannot be tied to this code — a stale
verdict from an earlier state would look identical to a current one.
Fix: record the reviewed revision in the verdict (e.g. a 'Revision: b5c9dd3'
line), or re-review at the current HEAD and record its SHA.

Gate 2 is human-approved and has no exceptions (.claude/rules/gate-rules.md).
This check proves only that the paperwork exists and is self-consistent;
it does not and cannot prove a human approved anything.
